independence: Fresh-context independent integration/control reviewer; no source, proof, interpretation or prior-result edits.
scope: Final check003 runner, numerical evidence, interpretation, discoveries, proof composition and preserved source versions; finite diagnostic acceptance only.

assessments.assessment: Native Jacobians are transformed from log-gap tau coordinates to independent log(tau) using chart_shape_jacobian. Basis derivatives are whitened, then multiplied by sigma before comparison. Boundary-voltage and R amplitude columns recover separate free/forced RC contributions with terminal-voltage minus signs. Derivative defects therefore have V per unit log(tau), and scalar native gap combines quantities of different units; the report correctly says respective units rather than calling that scalar a voltage error.

assessments.topic: Public inputs, chronology and truth separation
assessments.assessment: Only public t0_a0 query/configuration are read from the old registration. RC boundary voltages are explicitly overridden, arbitrary observed voltage is never fitted, and hidden plant state is not used for centering or correction. All 600 actual intervals and sample order are propagated; 35 Hz is nominal build configuration, not a replacement for irregular dt. Seven probes are evaluations of the same fixture, not seven independent evidence blocks.

Random correlated designs validate exact quadratic displacement and nuisance projection with full joint cross terms; information-normalized bounds expose weak directions. Value-exact derivative error and the weak-design negative control are correctly scoped. Fresh additive-only repeated fits match final U1; retained-prior and changed-design counterexamples prevent the previously overbroad interpretation. No covariance calibration or physical fit claim is made.

Affine state and positive-kernel controls implement distinct error recurrences. Artificial final-health and label-bias examples match the report without selecting a physical evolution law. Shared support, kernel premises, prior ownership and no replay duplication remain explicit. Physical relaxation is never used to certify lifetime likelihood accuracy.

Paired and independent coefficient examples use the same equilibrium and retain the stable finite recurrence. Factor identities include derivative and cross terms; PSD rank-loss control is valid. No runtime cache or quantizer is implemented. H2 4760 B factor and 5168 B lower subtotal plus hypothetical 568/1800 B increments are arithmetically correct and exclude full workspace/platform costs.

R1, U1, A1 and O1 final hashes match their individual conditional acceptances. O1 relies on unchanged U1 information-normalization sections, not the revised repetition claim. Archived R1/U1 objections and three controls remain intact. Current report/discovery claims agree with finite numerical values and preserve unresolved coverage, model, lifetime and target-resource premises.

nonblocking_notes.note: The guide now accurately states that registration.json binds sources while result.json binds the baseline public-profile registration and test inputs. The saved numerical results and all original registrations remain unchanged. The completed pair is reproducibly bound, as independently verified. A future reusable runner could additionally bind/recheck the baseline file before/after execution; this is not required to accept the saved check003 evidence.

limits: Acceptance concerns finite deterministic controls and consistency with conditional proofs; no uniform-domain approximation or calibrated physical coverage follows.
No fitted-cell experiment, campaign, aging-law qualification, ten-year accuracy, useful autonomous recovery or complete Cortex-M23 memory/timing qualification was performed.
The report and discovery register are accepted only at the recorded hashes. Pending top-level project-state updates and final receipt are outside this artifact review.
Only this review JSON is newly written in the repository; temporary replay build/results remain under /tmp.
